modalities.evidence: Magnetoencephalographic (MEG) Pitch and Duration Mismatch Negativity

output.population: 60 human participants: healthy controls, first-episode schizophrenia, and first-episode affective psychosis
output.summary: MEG recordings of an auditory oddball paradigm with standard, pitch deviant and duration deviant tones, measuring mismatch negativity in first-episode psychosis. Clinical, neuropsychological, demographic and medication data accompany the recordings.
